trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload on Android 14. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. Deadline: Fixed and verified by Wednesday (prior to the August 20th release).

trello.name: Verify Android 14 crash fix
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Confirm the fix for the Android 14 photo upload crash on Android 14 test devices once Marcus lands it. Add this verification to the regression run.

trello.name: Implement offline mode sync API
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Build the backend sync API endpoint where the client sends its last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Implement last-write-wins conflict resolution. Deadline: Code in review before Elena's leave on Aug 17th.

trello.name: Implement offline mode client side
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Implement local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, and replay them when connectivity is restored. Acceptance criteria: User can open the app in airplane mode, see notes, edit them, and reconcile data upon reconnection with no data loss. Write these criteria into the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Finish test and release pipelines in GitHub Actions, keeping the nightly build schedule. Run Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week to ensure stability before decommissioning Jenkins. Keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean.

trello.name: Implement search endpoint rate limiting
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint: 100 requests per minute per user. Return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header when the limit is exceeded. Add a metrics counter to track who is hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update privacy policy screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Update the consent screen to meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. Change from a single pre-checked box to opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing. Get new copy from legal. This is a launch blocker for the August 20th release.

trello.name: Write automated tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Write regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation. Integrate these tests into CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
